change.summary: Expire a sanitized Weekly quota observation in an already-running router when its explicit reset boundary is reached, refresh the protected status projection and queue private-state persistence.

before_implementation.observed_failure: After the fixture clock crossed resets_at, the running router still exposed remaining_ratio 0.25 instead of null.
before_implementation.bounded_cleanup: The failed assertion left the fixture listener open; the test command was terminated after its 30-second bound and the fixture now registers unconditional cleanup.

covers: HTTP/SSE bounded pre-semantic failover and post-semantic no-replay
WebSocket bounded pre-semantic failover and post-semantic no-replay
weekly persistence, reset-derived cooldown, restart and live reset expiry
protected status refresh and sanitized fail-closed error handling

deployment.reason: The previously proven sudo root-GID transition failure and non-writable /opt/codex-account-router boundary are unchanged.

remaining_limits: 0.2.10 is verified but is not active until a host-privileged operator runs the rollback-capable router-only deployment script.
Weekly observations without an explicit reset timestamp remain valid until a later validated observation; the router does not guess provider reset times.
A protected status read performs the live prune; no background timer is introduced.
Weekly reset expiry does not close or shorten an independent open circuit or its bounded cooldown.
Generic 429 responses do not prove weekly exhaustion.
Real two-account verification remains blocked until explicit enrollment authorization.
